usage: agentbreeder services up [-h] --environment ENVIRONMENT
                                [--locked | --update] [--env-file ENV_FILE]
                                [--yes] [--repin] [--allow-project-mcp NAME]
                                [--json] [--expect-grant SHA256]
                                [dir]

positional arguments:
  dir

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
  --locked              Refuse any stack.lock change
  --update              Accept new hashes for edited project files (file
                        params); never for a published service version
  --env-file ENV_FILE   KEY=value file for imported variables
  --yes                 Confirm a new or changed grant (and new tool pins of
                        built-in MCP servers)
  --repin               Review MCP tool definitions that changed upstream and
                        pin them again
  --allow-project-mcp NAME
                        Allow a non-built-in mcp: entry that sends a
                        credential upstream (repeatable); with --yes it also
                        accepts that server's new tool pins
  --json
  --expect-grant SHA256
                        Refuse unless the grant has this digest
